question.prompt: Name a NASA spacecraft sent on a mission to explore Mars. Landers, rovers and failed missions count.

answers.evidence: Curiosity is listed as NASA's Mars Science Laboratory rover, launched in 2011.
Perseverance is listed as the NASA rover carried by the Mars 2020 mission.
Opportunity is listed as a NASA Mars rover launched in July 2003.
Spirit is listed as a NASA Mars rover launched in June 2003.
Ingenuity is listed as the NASA helicopter sent with the Mars 2020 mission.
Sojourner is listed as the NASA rover launched with Mars Pathfinder.
Mars Pathfinder is listed as a NASA Mars lander launched in December 1996.
InSight is listed as a NASA Mars lander launched in May 2018.
Phoenix is listed as a NASA Mars lander launched in August 2007.
The Viking 1 lander is listed as a successful NASA Mars lander.
The Viking 1 orbiter is separately listed as a successful NASA Mars spacecraft.
The Viking 2 lander is listed as a successful NASA Mars lander.
The Viking 2 orbiter is separately listed as a successful NASA Mars spacecraft.
Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter is listed as a NASA Mars orbiter launched in 2005.
MAVEN is listed as a NASA Mars orbiter launched in November 2013.
Mars Odyssey is listed as the NASA orbiter launched on the 2001 Mars Odyssey mission.
Mars Global Surveyor is listed as a successful NASA Mars orbiter launched in 1996.
Mariner 4 is listed as a successful NASA Mars flyby spacecraft launched in 1964.
Mariner 9 is listed as a successful NASA Mars orbiter launched in 1971.
Mariner 3 is listed as a NASA Mars flyby attempt that suffered a launch failure.
Mariner 6 is listed as a successful NASA Mars flyby spacecraft launched in 1969.
Mariner 7 is listed as a successful NASA Mars flyby spacecraft launched in 1969.
Mariner 8 is listed as a NASA Mars orbiter attempt that suffered a launch failure.
Mars Observer is listed as a NASA Mars orbiter mission that ended in spacecraft failure.
Mars Climate Orbiter is listed as NASA's failed Mars Surveyor '98 orbiter spacecraft.
Mars Polar Lander is listed as NASA's failed Mars Surveyor '98 lander spacecraft.
Deep Space 2 (A) is listed as a NASA penetrator launched with the Mars Surveyor '98 lander mission.
Deep Space 2 (B) is separately listed as a NASA penetrator launched with the Mars Surveyor '98 lander mission.
MarCO-A is listed as a NASA Mars flyby spacecraft launched alongside InSight.
MarCO-B is separately listed as a NASA Mars flyby spacecraft launched alongside InSight.
ESCAPADE Blue is listed as a NASA / UC Berkeley spacecraft launched toward Mars in November 2025.
ESCAPADE Gold is separately listed as a NASA / UC Berkeley spacecraft launched toward Mars in November 2025.

question.explanation: These spacecraft appear under NASA, or NASA / UC Berkeley, in the supplied Mars-mission list. Failed launches and lost spacecraft count, as do separately named landers, rovers, penetrators and the Ingenuity helicopter. Missions that only used Mars for a gravity assist are excluded.
